Chapter 881: Chapter 19: Guaranteed Win (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 881: Chapter 19: Guaranteed Win (Please Subscribe)

The Yu Clan originated from the Universe Clan at the dawn of the universe.

And the Universe Clan is the oldest and most mysterious group.

In the vast universe, ancient and modern times span broadly.

The only ones who could stand alongside the Universe Clan at its peak…

were probably the Robber Clan from the previous Cosmic Era.

However, the Robber Clan was suppressed by the cosmic will, and their numbers had an irremediable deficiency.

…

The 84th treasure of the Yu Clan’s treasury, even within the Universe Clan of old, could be ranked among the top 100 treasures.

In terms of preciousness, it surpasses ordinary supreme weapons.

After all, whether it was the previous Universe Clan or the current Yu Clan.

The supreme weapons they recorded all far exceeded a hundred.

Soon.

Fan Gaomo arrived at the Yu Clan’s treasury.

“I am here by the ‘Emperor’s’ command to take the 84th treasure.”

Fan Gaomo stood outside the treasury and spoke.

The Yu Clan’s treasury is always watched by guards; even if a Twelfth Layer Ultimate were to arrive, they couldn’t forcibly take the treasure and flee.

“Access approved, the 84th treasure, left from the past Cosmic Era, use it carefully,” a voice came from inside the treasury.

Theoretically speaking, once the universe enters its late stages and completes a full Cosmic Era, all rules and paths will collapse.

Even a Twelfth Layer Ultimate, if they do not choose to enter the Chaos Void and remain in the universe, will ultimately die.

The Robber Clan surviving the past Cosmic Era is entirely a special case, and this is their biggest secret.

However.

It’s fundamentally impossible for life to traverse between two Cosmic Eras.

But treasures, especially certain special treasures, might be able to move from one Cosmic Era to the next.

If a treasure doesn’t have a specific consciousness, it merely needs to withstand the physical destruction and collapse of the universe.

For life, it involves facing destruction on the soul and the level of will.

…

As the earliest born clan, the Universe Clan first scavenged the universe; many treasures from the previous Cosmic Era that have remained into the current one, mostly ended up in the Universe Clan’s hands.

Later, the Universe Clan split into the Yu Clan and Zhou Clan, each inheriting a part of the original Universe Clan’s essence.

The 84th treasure is one of them.

…

Soon.

A pure golden ‘balance scale’ appeared in front of Fan Gaomo.

“Balance Scale!”

Fan Gaomo was slightly stirred.

If not for the Galaxy Master, he likely wouldn’t have had the chance to encounter this treasured item.

The effects of the Balance Scale are simple.

‘Equivalent’ exchange.

As long as an item is placed on one side of the scale, it can forcibly exchange a corresponding item from the enemy within a certain time.

For example, placing one’s main battle weapon on one side of the scale and then targeting an enemy will make the enemy’s main battle weapon disappear for a while.

Or seal some of its power for a while.

The term ‘item’ here isn’t limited to physical objects; it includes many conceptual things.

Such as lifespan?

Of course, the Balance Scale can only be used between equals, and there is ‘loss’ during the exchange.

If you use tens of thousands of years of your own lifespan, you might only exchange a few thousand years of the enemy’s lifespan.

And the item you put in will be permanently lost, while the enemy’s item will only be restricted for some time.

It seems somewhat unfair.

But one must know, the right to use the Balance Scale is in your own hands; you can create fatal flaws for the enemy at critical moments.

Even a Twelfth Layer Ultimate, if forcibly exchanged by the Balance Scale, will lose part of their power temporarily.

…

“What ability of the Galaxy Master do you plan to exchange?”

The voice inside the treasury came; naturally, the treasury guards knew the purpose for which Fan Gaomo took the 84th treasure, as the impact of events on a large-scale battlefield is significant.

“What ability?”

Fan Gaomo fell into thought; the Balance Scale is exceedingly heaven-defying, but it must be used correctly.

“Exchange lifespan?”

The treasury guard asked.

“Lifespan?”

“No.”

“It’s not worth it.”

Fan Gaomo immediately shook his head.

If the Galaxy Master were still at the ninth or tenth layer, this method might be worth a try.

But now? The Galaxy Master has already reached the eleventh layer, theoretically without lifespan limitations, how much lifespan would need to be put in to reduce the Galaxy Master’s lifespan to a critical point?

And reducing the lifespan to a critical point doesn’t affect their power.

Most importantly, the lifespan forcibly exchanged from the enemy is only temporary and will recover after a while.

“Is it the ultimate essence in the hands of the Galaxy Master?” the treasury guard continued.

“Ultimate essence?” Fan Gaomo shook his head immediately.

To exchange the Galaxy Master’s ultimate essence, Fan Gaomo would have to offer an ultimate essence of the Yu Clan permanently, a loss he naturally wouldn’t want to bear.

And he has no right to bear it, the Emperor of the Yu Clan would be the first to disallow it.

After pondering for a long time, Fan Gaomo solemnly said, “I want to exchange the life essence of the Galaxy Master.”

“Not a bad idea.”

The treasury guard nodded, clearly quite in agreement.

Life essence is the most fundamental manifestation of life; the size of one’s own projection in the river of time corresponds to the height of their life essence.

Fan Gaomo didn’t want to give up one of his ultimate essences to seal the ultimate essence of the Galaxy Master.

But he could completely make the Galaxy Master lose the ability to use the ultimate essence.
